public_text:
Welcome back, Rowan! Good news: automatic reminders at 3, 7 and 14 days overdue, with friendly, neutral and firm tones, shipped in v0.6 on 12 Aug and have been tested with real partner data. They came straight from the September interviews, where 10 of 12 agencies said chasing by hand was their most-hated admin task.
> Automatic reminders at 3, 7 and 14 days overdue (each one can be switched off).
— product.md §2, 20 Oct
Also: status.md §1, research.md §2

Good news: direct debit through GoCardless is in the product, so agencies can avoid card fees on large invoices. It came from the interviews, where 7 of 12 named card fees as a pain. Heads-up for partner comms: it's still shipped-untested (sandbox only), and a live test is booked for 17 Nov.
> **Direct debit through GoCardless**, so agencies avoid card fees on large invoices.
— product.md §3, 20 Oct
Also: status.md §2, research.md §2

Good news: each client gets a portal where they can download their invoice PDFs and payment receipts, and update their billing contact. The portal has been tested with real partner data.
> Each client gets a portal listing all their invoices.
— product.md §5, 20 Oct
Also: status.md §1
